attributes.action: Reverse all ISA reforms due to take effect in April 2027
attributes.additional_details: We call on the Government to repeal all ISA reforms announced in the Autumn Budget that are due to take effect from April 2027, preserving the current tax-free ISA system and protecting responsible savers.
attributes.background:
Reversal of all ISA reforms announced in the Autumn Budget:
Reduction of the Cash ISA allowance,
22% tax charge on cash held within Stocks & Shares ISAs
Restrictions on money market funds
Restrictions on transfers between ISA types

rejection.details:
We already have two petitions open that cover your request - you may wish to sign either or both of these:

Abandon planned cuts to the annual Cash ISA subscription limit
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775333

Do Not Tax Uninvested Cash Held Within Stocks and Shares ISAs
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774871
